description: This file defines the RegistrationEventProcessorFactory class which creates instances of different registration event processors based on the event type. It is part of the registration processing subsystem within the OrangeHRM core plugin.

classes.name: RegistrationEventProcessorFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for instantiating registration event processor objects based on the provided event type.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventProcessor
methods.description: Returns an appropriate registration event processor instance based on the given event type. Throws an exception if the event type is invalid.
